summary.headline: Genethliacal Day and Imperial Reigns
summary.text: Calendar calculation derives the genethliacal day from the Sun in Sagittarius and Moon in Virgo, using additions, subtractions, and nineteen-year cycles. The computation is then carried through the reigns of Augustus, Tiberius, Gaius, Claudius, Nero, Vespasian, Titus, Domitian, Nerva, Trajan, Hadrian, Antoninus, Lucius Commodus, Severus, Alexander, Maximian, Gordian, and Philip.
